item.title: Epilogue
item.description:
[[Pi]] EPILOGUE

Many friends and well-wishers of the author and some readers of the volumes of the History of Dharmaśāstra have often ( personally and by correspondence) pressed him to furnish some biographical details about himself, about the circumstances in which he launched on this undertaking, about the preparations [[be|he]] made, about the time and labour that this undertaking cost him and also what money it brought to him (a few asked even this ).

item.title: Word Index
item.description:
[[P1]] INDEX (to vol. V)

a. = author; Acc. = According; M = mentioned by or in; Q. = quoted by or in

(Important and rare words are put in Italics)

Abbreviations, su di and va di or ba di explained, 670.

Abhayagaṇa, mantras so called 796n

Abhaya, mantras in Atharvaveda, 769n.

Abhayamudrā, defined and illustrated, 1131n.

Abhaya-śānti, described, 761.

Abhihitānvayavādinaḥ, followers of Kumārila were so called, 1297.

Abhijit, m. as 28th nakṣatra after Uttarāṣāḍhā and before Śravaṇa, 497-98; m. in Tai. Br., Mai. S. and Atharvaveda, though not m. in Tai. S. and Kāṭhaka S. 520; myth about its disappearance, 497n; said to be younger sister of Rohiṇī, 497n.
